subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add a producer-owned structured progress metrics contract to plugin hook events, and which runtime source owns `stepTotal`, `percent`, ETA, and terminal metrics across run paths?
rationale: The missing field is source-reproducible, but choosing authoritative progress semantics changes public Plugin SDK behavior and should not be invented by automation.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and cover core producers with tests.

options.title: Keep hooks unchanged
options.body: Leave plugins to derive progress from lifecycle and tool events, accepting text-only live cards until a stronger progress model exists.

options.title: Create a separate progress event
options.body: Design a dedicated progress event or task-flow projection instead of attaching percentages to existing hook payloads.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and cover core producers with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior hook payload correlation work is the closest current-main ownership trail for this public hook contract choice.
